standard-dialogue-if-the-player-did-not-.speaker: Sir Kit Breaker
standard-dialogue-if-the-player-did-not-.text: Hello! The name's Kit. Sir Kit Breaker.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-did-not-.player: Sir Kit? That's a nice name!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-did-not-.speaker: Sir Kit Breaker
standard-dialogue-if-the-player-did-not-.text: Thank you! I chose it myself!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-did-not-.player: ... Thinking about it, I chose mine as well. I'm [player name], by the way.
What do you do around here?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-did-not-.speaker: Sir Kit Breaker
standard-dialogue-if-the-player-did-not-.text: I'm helping Gilbert with a project of his, on behalf of the White knights. It will take us a while but I can let you know when we're closer to completion!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.speaker: Sir Kit Breaker
standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.text: [player name], it's good to see you.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.player: How are you getting on as a White Knight?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.speaker: Sir Kit Breaker
standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.text: It's going well, thank you. Being on loan to Gilbert and the Glade project is giving me good purpose whilst I do all the basic training.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.player: Gilbert's not working you too hard is he?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.speaker: Sir Kit Breaker
standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.text: Not yet at least, until we get started on the land. For now it's mostly tending to the flowers and wandering... Patrolling around!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.speaker: Sir Kit Breaker
standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.text: I can't thank you enough, [player name]. I hope you'll pop by one day as the Glade project progresses. Don't be a stranger!

standard.npc: Oh, I do declare! Another perambulating soul traipses through this verdant forest!
Salutations, my good compatriot! Pray, what curious happenstance is it that brings yourself out to my sylvan domicile?
The rainforest! A most resplendent deviation from the cacophonous tyranny of urban existence.

standard.player: It's certainly more colourful, that's for sure.

standard.npc: Indeed! Out here, one may emancipate themselves amidst blissful tranquility.

standard.player: I see... So how does such a... magniloquent individual... come to be out here?

standard.npc: Well, it commenced when I was merely a youth, and has proceeded uninterrupted ever since.

standard.player: You came out here as a child?

standard.npc: I was most fortuitously deposited within this locale by my progenitors, along with this extravagant bundle of novels. Behold this one!

standard.text: The odd individual shows you a book.

standard.npc: What an exquisitely scandalous read it was. Now, you seem like someone who appreciates linguistic variety! Would you care to partake in a spot of intellectual cultivation with me?

standard.player: I'm not sure if that's quite...

standard.npc: I possess a cornucopia of literary marvels. This one by Di. C. Tionary is captivating.

standard.text: The odd individual shows you another book.

standard.npc: No! Di. C. Tionary. She's one of the foremost novelists of our time. Such an unparalleled way with words. I'd love to have an audience with her some day.
Tell me, have you met any of the literary greats?

standard.player: I've not had an opportunity to.

standard.npc: A tragedy, to be unequivocally certain.

standard.player: Yes... Anyway, I think I need to get going now...

standard.npc: Very well! I shan't exasperate you with excessive and superfluous conversation. Besides, my tomes beckon. Farewell.

standard-dialogue-using-an-item-on-him.npc: I have little to say on this object. Congratulations on your ownership of it.

standard.npc: Ho, [Fremennik name]! The brave warrior returns!

standard.player: It was a hard-fought battle, but we Fremennik prevailed!

standard.npc: I expect we'll be hearing songs about the 'Slayer of the Troll King' for many years to come.

standard.player: It would be an honour to be remembered in such a way! Thanks.

standard.npc: Kebabs! Get your kebabs here! One gold each!

steps.text: With 1 coin:
kebab
Without 1 coin:

steps.npc: Yes? Are you going to give me that one gold coin then?

steps.player: Sorry, I don't seem to have any money on me.

steps.npc: The bank is Keldagrim-West. Hurry back!

options.text: I'm looking for a drunken dwarf.

steps.player: I'm looking for a drunken dwarf.

steps.text: If the player has not completed the Forgettable Tale... quest:

steps.npc: Just go out in the streets, they can't be hard to find!

steps.player: No, a specific drunken dwarf, he keeps harassing me.

steps.npc: That's still not very helpful. But let me see. There is one particularly drunken dwarf just to the northeast of here.
He's scaring away my customers, he says there's something wrong with my kebabs. Quite annoying fellow.

steps.player: I don't think that's who I mean.

steps.npc: Well, he does have a relative who wanders all over Gielinor. Comes back from time to time to buy more kebabs. Don't see him very often though.

steps.player: Do you think I'll have any chance of catching him here?

steps.npc: I think he was back here quite recently, so I doubt he'll be back any time soon.

steps.text: If the player has completed the Forgettable Tale... quest:

steps.npc: I thought you would know plenty!
Oh come on! You in the Laughing Miner? The whole city knows about you and your dwarven drinking buddies!
Not really! I have a steady supply of meat coming in through the carts and I don't really need anything else!

standard-dialogue-using-an-item-on-his-f.npc: Hey, what are you trying to put into my kebabs? Get away from there, get your own fireplace!

standard-dialogue-using-an-item-on-his-s.npc: Hey, do you mind? That's my property!

standard-dialogue-after-completing-under.npc: Hello again adventurer, so you're still around?

steps.npc: Well..yes, but they're not cheap to make. I'll have to sell you a pair...
5,000 coins.
We don't joke down here friend...

options.text: Okay then, I'll take a pair.

steps.player: Okay then, I'll take a pair.

steps.text: If the player has 5000 coins:
Klank sells you some gauntlets.

steps.npc: There you go... I hope they help.

steps.text: If the player does not have enough coins:

steps.player: Oh dear, I haven't got enough money...

steps.npc: Sorry, I can't sell them any cheaper than that.
You too adventurer...

after-dragon-slayer-i.npc: No, it's not. It may, to the untrained eye, at first appear to be the Lady Lumbridge, but it is definitely not. It's my new ship. It just happens to look slightly similar, is all.

after-dragon-slayer-i.player: It has Lady Lumbridge painted out and 'Klarense's Cruiser' painted over it!

after-dragon-slayer-i.npc: Nope, you're mistaken. It's my new boat.

after-dragon-slayer-i.player: Well will you at least take me to Crandor in it?

after-dragon-slayer-i.npc: Nope. I don't take passengers on my ship.

after-dragon-slayer-i-when-trying-to-boa.npc: Hey, stay off my ship! That's private property!

initial-dialogue-after-finishing-icthlar.npc: Thank you, adventurer. You have given my soul some respite.

overhead-dialogue-song.text: Like a party animal in the groove

standard.player: Who are you? What are you doing here in the snow?

standard.speaker: Knight
standard.text: My name is...Sir Gerry. I am...a member of a secret...society of knights. My time is short and I need...your help.
If the player has not completed Recruitment Drive:

steps.player: A secret society of knights? What a surprise! Is there an old charter or decree that says if you're a knight you have to belong to a secret order?

steps.speaker: Knight
steps.text: I'm sorry, my friend... I do not understand your meaning. Please, time is short... Take this scroll to Sir Tiffy. You will find him in Falador park... You should not...read it... It contains information for his eyes only.
The knight hands you a scroll.

standard.text: If the player has completed Recruitment Drive:

steps.player: A secret society of knights? You don't mean the Temple Knights, do you?

steps.speaker: Knight
steps.text: Yes! Praise Saradomin! You...have been sent in...my hour of need. Please, take...this scroll to Sir Tiffy in Falador park... You should not...read it.
The knight hands you a scroll.

standard-dialogue-trying-to-talk-to-the-.text: He's still alive, but in no condition to talk. He appears to be almost comatose.

standard-dialogue-upstairs.speaker: Knight of Ardougne
standard-dialogue-upstairs.text: Hello there citizen. What can I do for you?

standard-dialogue-upstairs.speaker: Knight of Ardougne
standard-dialogue-upstairs.text: These stairs lead to the Ardougne Prison. It's home to thieves, murderers and everything in between.

standard-dialogue-upstairs.player: Sounds lovely. Can I go in?

standard-dialogue-upstairs.speaker: Knight of Ardougne
standard-dialogue-upstairs.text: I'm afraid not citizen. Only the Knights of Ardougne are allowed into the prison and I can see that you are no knight.

standard-dialogue-trying-to-go-downstair.speaker: Knight of Ardougne
standard-dialogue-trying-to-go-downstair.text: Sorry citizen. Only Knights of Ardougne are allowed in the prison.

standard-dialogue-when-wearing-ardougne-.speaker: Knight of Ardougne
standard-dialogue-when-wearing-ardougne-.text: Hello there fellow knight. Isn't today a wonderful day to be a Knight of Ardougne?

standard-dialogue-when-wearing-ardougne-.player: I mean it's okay I suppose. The constant fear of some random adventurer murdering you and the fact that people are constantly picking your pockets isn't great. But hey ho, at least the benefits are good.

standard-dialogue-when-wearing-ardougne-.speaker: Knight of Ardougne
standard-dialogue-when-wearing-ardougne-.text: That they are fellow knight, that they are.

standard-dialogue-when-wearing-ardougne-.player: Anyway, can I go down these stairs?

standard-dialogue-when-wearing-ardougne-.speaker: Knight of Ardougne
standard-dialogue-when-wearing-ardougne-.text: Of course you can! You're a Knight of Ardougne! There is no place where you can't go.

standard-dialogue-downstairs.speaker: Knight of Ardougne
standard-dialogue-downstairs.text: Hmm... Is your head working okay today [Tim/Sue]?

standard-dialogue-downstairs.player: Of course, my head has never been better.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player has not spoken to him before:

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Ah, nilsal! Hello!

standard-dialogue.text: If the player has spoken to him before:

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Ah, hello again!

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: I'm a Knight of Varlamore, the Kingdom of Sun. I venture to Kourend on a mission, one I can say very little of.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: I'm afraid you must accept my secrecy adventurer, for who knows what the future holds.
other

options.text: I found an ancient sun temple.
options.condition: If the player completed In Search of Knowledge:

steps.player: I found an ancient sun temple.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Oh, pray tell, where is this temple?

steps.player: In a place called the Forthos Ruin to the south east of here. I was exploring there and I discovered symbology for an entity called Ralos.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: I see. I think I shall check out this ruin. Thank you for letting me know adventurer.

steps.player: No problem... Oh, I don't know your name.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Call me Astra! Now, I must see this discovery for myself. It may well help with my mission here. May the light shine upon you!
Astra leaves the castle, and moves to the Altar of the Sun.

options.condition: If the player has never been to Varlamore:

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: To the south, beyond Mount Quidamortem. It's a glorious land where the sun forever shines.
other

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Stay vigilant, friend.
other

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Not great... Can you believe what they've done?

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Are you blind? Look what they've done to the altar of Ralos!

steps.player: Oh... I guess it has seen better days.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: It was those others! Those undead druids. Blind moon worshippers...

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: Do you see what they've become? That's what turning your back on the light does. Even as I stand here in this desecrated temple, I feel the light fading from me.

steps.player: I suppose it is quite spooky down here.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: So you feel it too? A shadow hangs over this place.

steps.speaker: Knight of Varlamore
steps.text: My mission is still a secret, adventurer. Perhaps I'll share it with you one day.

standard.npc: Woo wooo!

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Who are you?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: Don't you know? I am a proud Knight of the Lion, serving under the Justiciar of the Lion.
And you are the adventurer who disturbed my rest!

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Yeah... I'm not really all that sorry about that. I was searching for Hallowed marks. Although I didn't actually intend to disturb you if that's any consolation.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: Hallowed marks? That currency is reserved only for the devout followers of holy Saradomin. Are you a follower, adventurer?

steps.text: If the player has at least one Saradomin item equipped:

steps.npc: I see! Yes, I can sense that you at least carry some items bearing his symbol. Well met fellow follower! Do tell, what is the Justiciar of the Lion up to these days?

steps.player: The Justiciar of the Lion? I've never heard of them.

steps.npc: By Saradomin's mercy! Are you serious adventurer? You've never heard of her glory?
The statue in the south east bears her resemblance. I remember the day it was built in her honour.
The Justiciar of the Lion is a title bestowed upon the most powerful wizard of our order. She was capable of wiping out an entire army of Zamorakian demons with a single spell!
I lament that I could not learn more from her in life but I do not regret for a single instant following her to my grave.

steps.player: I see, she sounds like an inspirational figure indeed. Do you know where I can find her?

steps.npc: I was hoping that you could tell me. Last I heard, she was residing in the college here in Hallowvale.
Is something wrong adventurer?

steps.player: Never mind, you don't want to know.

steps.text: If the player has no Saradomin items equipped:

steps.npc: You lie adventurer. I do not sense a single item of holy Saradomin on your person.
To think that our currency is being handled by non- followers. It's a disgrace! If I weren't dead, I'd incinerate you where you stand for your impudence!

steps.player: Yeah well, you are dead and I have your currency so you're going to have to... live with that!

steps.npc: I don't appreciate your attempts at humour, non- follower.
To think that our currency is being handled by non- followers. It's a disgrace! If I weren't dead, I'd incinerate you where you stand for your impudence!

steps.player: Yeah well, you are dead and I have your currency so you're going to have to... live with that!

steps.npc: I don't appreciate your attempts at humour, non- follower.

upon-opening-a-coffin-in-the-hallowed-se.npc: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!

standard.npc: Woo wooo?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Who are you?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: Who indeed? I am a wise Knight of the Owl. I serve the Justiciar of the Owl.

options.text: Who's this Justiciar of the Owl?

steps.player: Who's this Justiciar of the Owl?

steps.text: If the player has not completed Mage Arena II:

steps.npc: Saradomin's wisest of servants. It surprises me that you've not heard of his many feats.
I know them all.
Of course. Do you see the foliage around you, adventurer?
For it to be in such a state means that there is unimaginable evil nearby. These plants were grown personally by Zachariah, the Justiciar of the Owl.
Anything he plants blossoms with unimaginable vigour. You may have noticed that he has a love for lilies. Perhaps he knew they'd serve multiple purposes in a place like this.

steps.player: Hmm. Hopefully I'll meet him one day.

steps.npc: If you do, send my regards.
I'm but a loyal watcher, that is all.
So, was there anything else?

steps.text: other
If the player has completed Mage Arena II:

steps.player: Your helmet looks familiar. I defeated a knight who wore one with a similar design.

steps.npc: This helmet? It is based on the one worn by the Justiciar of the Owl. You mean to say you fought the great Zachariah and lived to tell the tale?
This can't be... You killed the great Zachariah?

steps.player: Hmm, he didn't really die. He just sort of faded away and left behind a glowing magical hand.

steps.npc: Strange, when I saw him last he had no magical hand to speak of... I suppose time has changed the world above beyond my recollection...

steps.text: other

steps.npc: They are a symbol of the wise. You see, owls can see the light in the darkest of places. Their presence within the sepulchre is one of grave importance.

steps.player: Yes, I saw some down there. They seemed incorporeal in some way, as if they were ghosts...

steps.npc: Indeed. These creatures have the blessing of Saradomin and the wisdom of ages long past. They are the watchers of the Hallowed Sepulchre. The last defence against unseen evils.
The third floor... Home.
Thank you for freeing me, adventurer. If the owls have already retreated that far back, it's best that I reside here. From this position I can more effectively watch for evil.

steps.player: Hmm... Perhaps I should steal from graves more often?

steps.npc: Excuse me?

steps.text: other

steps.npc: Stay watchful.

upon-opening-a-coffin-in-the-hallowed-se.npc: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!

standard.npc: Woo wooo!

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Who are you?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: I am a holy Knight of the Unicorn. I served under the Archpriest of this place who himself served under the Justiciar of the Unicorn.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: You don't look like a knight... Don't knights wear plate armour and wield swords and lances and stuff?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: The title of knight perhaps has a different meaning to you adventurer. In fact, all of the knights of my order are priests who serve under Saradomin.
During my life, I spent my time here consecrating the fallen followers of holy Saradomin. I would perform their final rites before laying them to rest within this place.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: I see. So does this place only contain the bodies of these 'knights' who followed Saradomin?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: Not at all. We also provided these rites for all the citizens of Hallowvale. They were mostly laid to rest on the first two floors.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Interesting. So who is this Justiciar of the Unicorn you spoke of?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: The Justiciar of the Unicorn? Why this title is only bestowed upon the holiest priest of Saradomin.
The justiciar I followed would spread the teachings of Saradomin everywhere he went, converting the masses to our religion.
The statue in the north east of this room was created in his likeness when the place was built. I must say though, it does concern me that this is the first you've heard of him and his feats.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Well I've certainly heard of the word justiciar, but nothing about the Justiciar of the Unicorn.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: That saddens me greatly. I do hope that he is still carrying out Saradomin's will.
Anyway, do tell me adventurer, what brings you to the Hallowed Sepulchre?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: I found this place within the city of Darkmeyer and that mysterious stranger over there asked me to acquire some Hallowed marks which you and your bretheren were buried with.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: I see. Did you say Darkmeyer? An interesting name, especially when this region is so bright and full of life.
When I was alive this place was known as Hallowvale. Do you know why the queen decided to change the name?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Erm, simply put, the land here is... under new management.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: Hmm, interesting. I wish I could see for myself but unfortunately, I am unable to leave this place. I do wonder if this new 'management' is the reason my spirit did not pass on to the afterlife.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Perhaps so. However, it's probably best that you can't leave this place. I'm not sure you'd like what you'd find.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: I fear you may be right adventurer. The last instruction I was given was to help protect this place from invaders by placing magical enchantments on the statues within.
I admit, I never dared ask who or what we were protecting it from.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: If it's any consolation, the enchantments you placed did prevent the 'invaders' from entering. It's only us human adventurers who enter the Sepulchre.
Although we have been stealing some of your stuff... Sorry about that.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: It's not like I have any use for my stuff anymore. Thanks adventurer, your words do lighten my spirits somewhat.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Aren't you all spirit?

upon-opening-a-coffin-in-the-hallowed-se.npc: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!

standard.npc: Woo wooo?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Who are you?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: Me? I am a Knight of the Wolf. I serve the fierce Justiciar of the Wolf!

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Of the Wolf?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: Aye, the most loyal and fiercest of Saradomin's followers! We are the bastion against all that is evil.

options.text: Who's this Justiciar of the Wolf?

steps.player: Who's this Justiciar of the Wolf?

steps.npc: You haven't heard of...

I was hoping you could tell me... Ah, the white wolf we called her... For she had the brightest hair you'd ever seen. A silver so bright it could blind. Some said she had icyene blood, but those close to her knew better.

steps.player: I take it you were close?

steps.npc: Close enough. The white wolf was but a mere human, albeit with astounding prowess on the battlefield... She vied for Saradomin's attention the most out of all the justiciars.

steps.player: Hmm... Why do you think that was?

steps.npc: Ah, well... She always wanted to be stronger and never seemed happy with what she had. There was always more.
Was there anything else you wanted?

steps.text: other

options.text: Any great battles to speak of?

steps.player: Any great battles to speak of?

steps.npc: There was this time a great evil swept over Hallowvale...
The what?

steps.player: Y'know? The ones with the wings and all the blood sucking?

steps.npc: No, don't be so ridiculous. As I was saying... A great evil...
The common folk called it the Egregore. They said it could shift and change shape at a moments notice into creatures from the deepest abyss...
These folk, they tend to exaggerate. It wasn't until the nobles started spreading word of its ghoulish features, each more horrible than the last...
Talons as sharp as runite, fire-breath, mind reading abilities... Worst of all though, they said it couldn't be killed!
That was when we took an interest in killing the thing. We are Knights of the Wolf after all! Our duty is to eradicate all evil.

steps.player: Woah! How does one vanquish such a foe?

steps.npc: Well, we made short work of it. That is what we do.
With a big sword of course!

steps.text: If the player has Attack, Strength, or Defence as their highest combat skill:

steps.text: If the player has Ranged as their highest combat skill:

steps.player: Ah... I prefer a carefully placed arrow myself. Each to their own though.

steps.npc: It does the job! Once we had shown the head of the beast to the masses, talk of the Egregore soon died down. At least... for a while.
Yes. It was strange... As soon as the small folk had forgotten about the Egregore, rumours started to arise that it had returned. And so it had! That was the nature of this beast.
Does the Egregore still haunt these lands, human?

steps.player: Hmm, I can't say I've seen it...

steps.npc: Then you must assume we were quite successful! At least by the time of my passing, the beast hadn't returned. Although, who knows? It could have taken any form by now.

steps.player: Well I can't say for certain, but you look pretty old.

steps.npc: Your humour is wasted on me.

after-talking-to-captain-pudi-with-level.npc: That ungrateful Skipper. How dare he blame me for that freak storm?

options.text: Why are you angry at the Skipper?

steps.player: Why are you angry at the Skipper?

steps.npc: It be a long story.

steps.player: I've got time. I would love to hear it.

steps.npc: Fine, 'ere be me tale of misfortune.
About a half moon ago, we set sail on our fortnightly fishin' trip. 'Twas smooth sailin' all the way t' our spot.
Caught a load of manta ray an' snappers.
Ah, I should'a realised you were a landlubber. We on the ship call them snappers, but you lot call 'em lobsters.
Anyway, back to me tale.
After a couple o' days, we pulled up the anchor an' sailed closer t' the Karamjan coast. There is where the big'ns are.
You landlubbers... It be a shark.

steps.player: Oh, how was I supposed to know?

steps.npc: CAN YOU STOP INTERRUPTIN' ME TALE?
Good, now where was I...
When we arrived at the spot, the Skipper saw a lack of fish swimmin' in the waters.
I looked yonder onto the horizon an' noticed a storm was a brewin', so we adjusted our course accordin'.
As if by magic, winds started a blowin' an' the storm started movin' in our direction.
Lightnin' struck the boat, an' a piece of wood holdin' up the sail fell an' struck me on the 'ead.
I woke up in a bed an' the Skipper started on me, tellin' me I ruined his ship an' I need t' pay him back.

steps.player: That's awful. He does not sound like a nice man.

steps.npc: Nay, he usually is. He be upset about his ship, is all.
Can I help ye with anythin' else?

options.text: Can you give me any farming advice?

steps.player: Can you give me any farming advice?

steps.npc: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.

Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.

steps.npc: For many years I used my position to fight against the crime and corruption in this city. No matter what I did it was never enough though. I realised that to defeat my enemies I needed to act as they do.
That's why I formed the Saviours of Kourend. We take the laws into our own hands and fight against all who would damage this city, no matter who they are.

steps.npc: You've been here how long? You should know what we do by now.
Port Piscarilius is home to Kourend's fishermen and traders. We are the first port of call for any visitors to Kourend which means Port Piscarilius is home to a wide variety of individuals.
All people and goods coming to or from Kourend go through Port Piscarilius. This unfortunatly means that we are a centre point for the majority of crime within the city.
For many years I appealed to the Kourend Council for help in fighting this crime, but they cared little for us. Instead, I decided to beat them at their own game and fight fire with fire.

steps.npc: Combat Achievements are a set of tasks for all adventurers to try and accomplish. They range from simple missions to kill various creatures, to challenges that will push you to your limits.
The purpose of these tasks is for you to grow and improve, experience all that Gielinor has to offer, and become stronger in the process.
Is this something that sounds interesting to you?

options.text: Yes, tell me about Combat Achievements.

steps.player: Yes, tell me about Combat Achievements.

steps.npc: Combat Achievements are broken down into six tiers: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite, Master and Grandmaster.
As you complete tasks, you'll earn points. Tasks in higher tiers give more points than easier tasks. Your rank depends on how many points you've earned.
Whenever new tasks are added to the list, there are more points available to earn, so the threshold needed for each rank will increase. Keep completing tasks to maintain your rank!

steps.npc: This is the great Castle Wars arena! Here you can fight for the glory of Saradomin or Zamorak.

options.text: Really, how do I do that?

steps.player: Really, how do I do that?

steps.npc: Easy, you just step through one of the three portals. To join Zamorak, pass through the red portal. To join Saradomin, pass through the blue portal. If you don't mind then pass through the green portal.

Of course, there are always rules. Firstly you can't wear a cape as you enter the portal, you'll be given your team colours to wear while in the arena. You're also prohibited from taking non-combat related items in with you. So you should only have equipment, potions, and runes on you. Secondly, attacking your own team or your team's defences isn't allowed. You don't want to be angering your patron god, do you? Other than that, just have fun and enjoy it!

steps.player: It's a special device, invented by a friend of mine. If I'm wearing it while ranging, it uses magnets to retrieve some of my ammunition.

steps.npc: Oh. Gosh. That's clever. So are you wanting to take it into Castle Wars? The gods expect people to fight in the team capes.

steps.player: Can they be a bit more flexible, please?

steps.npc: I'll ask. Hold on a minute...
... (Lanthus communes with the gods.)

Bear in mind that you only need to be wearing it when you enter the game to get the benefit.

steps.npc: The name's Lara, this here is my canoe station.
I am employed here to keep it running. It's mine enough! Want to know more about canoes?
No problem, come back anytime.

steps.npc: You look like you have not used your axe much at all, I doubt you will be able to make any canoes.
Once you learn how to use your axe a bit more, you will be able to make a canoe to travel the river.

steps.text: With 12-26 Woodcutting:

steps.npc: I sure can, take your axe and chop this tree down here. You will then need to cut it into a canoe, easy stuff.
Well, you will not be able to turn this tree into one of the more reliable canoes just yet.
By looking at you and the way you hold your axe, you don't have the right skills for that. It will only take you to the next stop.

steps.text: With 27-41 Woodcutting:

steps.npc: I sure can, take your axe and chop this tree down here. You will then need to cut it into a canoe, easy stuff.

steps.player: How far will I be able to go in a dugout canoe?

steps.npc: Two stops, I would say.

steps.text: With 42-56 Woodcutting:

steps.npc: I sure can, take your axe and chop this tree down here. You will then need to cut it into a canoe, easy stuff.

steps.player: Really, how far will I be able to go?

steps.npc: Very far, but not the whole way, best keep swinging that axe of yours.

steps.npc: I sure can, take your axe and chop this tree down here. You will then need to cut it into a canoe, easy stuff.

options.text: Who are you and why are you here?

steps.player: Who are you and why are you here?

steps.npc: Once I was a merchant. I worked hard and became wealthy, very wealthy. I was brave too, storing my possessions in two great chests here, where few would dare to interfere with them.
But I was not strong enough. One day a witch allied with the pirates of the north; between their strength and her magic, they killed me. The pirates carried one of my chests away to their ship.
I keep vigil here now, as it interests me to watch adventurers come to raid this little chest, whenever they can find one of my keys.
My bigger chest was taken north to the pirates' ship - a brave adventurer may like to raid that one instead, if they can handle the perils of the north. I kept more wealth in that one.

steps.text: other

options.condition: If the player has a Larran's key in their inventory:

steps.npc: Well done, adventurer. I have two chests, containing my wealth from the days when I was alive. The smaller one is here, and the bigger one was taken far to the north, to the pirates' ship.
You can use the key to open either of them. The bigger one, in the pirates' ship, contains more wealth than this small one.

steps.text: other

steps.npc: If you want my worldly goods, open my chests with my keys. Adventurers occasionally find my keys while slaying monsters in the Wilderness, on assignment from the witch Krystilia.
I do not know why Krystilia sends adventurers to find my keys instead of looting the chest herself. Perhaps it amuses her to send people into this land to risk their lives.
I will be here if you return.

standard.npc: Oh, thank Armadyl! I am in such a worry... please help me!

steps.npc: Oh... it is terrible... horrible... My boyfriend lives here in this lighthouse, but I haven't seen him the last few days! I think something terrible has happened!
Look, you can see for yourself that the light has gone out, and the front door is locked up tight! He would NEVER do that!
With the light off this coastline is terribly dangerous to ships! And to lock the front door so that nobody can turn the light back on?

steps.player: Maybe he just went on holiday or something? Must be pretty boring living in a lighthouse.

steps.npc: That is terribly irresponsible! He is far too thoughtful for that! He would never leave it unattended! He would also never leave without telling me!
Please, I know something terrible has happened to him... I can sense it! Please... please help me adventurer!
Well, we have to do something to get the lighthouse working again! Also, as you may have noticed, the storm that knocked the bridge out
has trapped me on this causeway! You seem to have got here okay somehow, so if you could go and visit my cousin and get the spare key I left him,
as well as fix the bridge enough so that I can go and speak to my family in Rellekka and tell them whats happened, I will be eternally grateful!

steps.prompt: Start the Horror from the Deep quest?

steps.npc: OH! THANK YOU SO MUCH! I know my darling would never have left with the lighthouse lights off and without even telling me where he's gone!
My cousin was always interested in agility. He left our home in Rellekka many moons ago, so that he could pursue this interest.
I don't exactly know where he has gone, but I am sure he went somewhere to practise his agility. If you see him, his name is Gunnjorn. Mention my name, he will recognise it.

standard-dialogue-at-ardougne-zoo-before.player: What do you need my help for?

steps.player: Okay, why not! But first, who are you and why are you researching penguins?

steps.npc: I, uh, was a zoo keeper here. But, I, uh, am on leave to go research penguins in their native habitat.

steps.player: Ok! Okay then. So, what did you need me to do?

steps.npc: Right. I need you to gather materials for the bird hide, while I arrange for our transport.
You need to get 10 oak planks, 10 steel nails, a hammer, and a spade so that we can build a bird hide.
Once you have those, meet me up by the entrance to Keldagrim, east of Rellekka. I'll be there with a boat to take us to our destination.

standard.npc: Sorry, can't talk to ye right now. Busy with paperwork. If ye need anythin', talk t' Captain Pudi over by the dock.

options.text: I heard about your ship, can you tell me what happened?

steps.player: I heard about your ship. Can you tell me what happened?

steps.npc: Aye, I can tell ye what happened.
We be out on our fortnightly fishin' trip, I was doin' me normal work. Setting up the nets, swabbing the deck and the like.
'Twas a good hawl t' start, plenty of manta ray and snappers. But we would be movin' on the next day to our deep sea fishin' spot.
'Twas nothin' but smooth sailin' to our deep sea spot near Karamja, but on the way I noticed more debris in the water than usual.

steps.player: What kind of debris? Was it ship debris?

steps.npc: Aye, 'twas. Most of the time, it be nets or items people throw off ships that they don't need. This had me worried a bit.
There was a lack of fish in the water, 'twas kind of... eerie.
The next day, Koanee changed the ship's course, but that be because of a storm on the horizon.
But the storm seemed t' be... following us. As if it had a mind of its own.
The wind started a blowin' and the fog started a showin', huge waves crashing against the boat.
The ship started fallin' apart. I rushed to the cook's quarters and found 'im layin' on the floor with a plank over 'im.
I brought 'im up to the top deck and tied 'im to a piece of loose wood. I did the same t' the Skipper and Navigator.

steps.player: Oh my, that's awful! You're very lucky you didn't get hit.

steps.npc: Aye, it be lucky indeed. But that not be the end of it. As the ship finished sinking, I balanced out the wood so we did not slip.
In the distance I saw glowing eyes and a large monster sorta thing in the fog movin' t'wards us.
But all of a sudden, it vanished. I then had to keep us afloat 'till we made it t' shore by Al Kharid.
Pudi gathered us up and we went t' the Chancellor as soon as we could stand.
These ruins turned out t' be a great base to research the beast from undisturbed! Bit close to Menaphos though, aye?
That be the end of me story. Can I help ye with anything else?

standard.npc: Hello there. Do you have any questions about Leagues?

steps.npc: Leagues are time-limited challenges that provide a unique twist on the world you know and love.
With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the League.

steps.player: A fresh start? Why would I want that?

steps.npc: Glory, rewards, and the chance to do things in a different way!
First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.
The more points you have, the better League Rank you will be given.
Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off your accomplishments.
If that doesn't interest you, perhaps another reward might be more appealing? League Points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop.
You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to others!

steps.player: And if glory and rewards don't interest me?

steps.npc: Every League has unique rules and features. It's a very different world from the one you're used to.
For one thing, within the Leagues, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics which completely change the way you progress.
So even if glory and rewards aren't your thing, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!

steps.player: I see, thanks for the information.

steps.npc: My pleasure!

options.text: Is there currently a League running?

steps.player: Is there currently a League running?

steps.npc: Yes! The current League is Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded.
Within this League you are restricted to certain regions around Gielinor - although you'll get to choose which ones.
You can also collect powerful artefacts known as Relics. Each one provides a different buff to your League experience.
I heard there's one that lets you note items wherever you want, and one that makes shops free!
One other thing. You must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.

steps.player: Interesting. Maybe I should take part!

steps.npc: I'd highly recommend it!

steps.text: To take part in a League, you must be on a Leagues World. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

options.text: Can I purchase some League rewards?

steps.player: Can I purchase some League rewards?

steps.npc: Certainly! I have a number of unique rewards which you might be interested in.

options.text: Can we talk about League Trophies?

steps.player: Can we talk about League Trophies?

steps.npc: Of course! What would you like to know?
League Trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League Points you earned.
There are seven tiers of League Trophy: Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, Rune and Dragon.

standard-dialogue-leagues-worlds.speaker: Leagues Tutor
standard-dialogue-leagues-worlds.text: Hello mortal. What do you seek?

options.text: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.player: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: The great and terrible demon Yama has bound this League to his will.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Once again, regions contain monstrous Echo Bosses that can be defeated to earn unique and powerful rewards.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Yama, in his wisdom, has granted you the ability to augment your powers through Demonic Pacts. You may earn Demonic Pact points by completing Demonic Pact tasks.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Unlike before, you'll initially be restricted to the single Region of Varlamore. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Additionally, Misthalin will not be available at all this League, and once you reach the first task threshold Karamja will be unlocked for free.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: You must participate as an Ironman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: These experience increases are known as passive effects, which get more generous the higher your Relic tier.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests and more will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: I think that covers the basics. Would you like to know more, [player name]?
Opens Leagues Info panel

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you need from me?

options.text: Can you tell me about Demonic Pacts?

steps.player: Can you tell me about Demonic Pacts?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Demonic Pacts are new powers granted by Yama that modify and improve your combat abilities for the entire League.

steps.player: Why would Yama want to give me more power?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: It wouldn't be very entertaining to see you go up against Echo Bosses with your mortal prowess now would it?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: At least, not for very long. Death comes easily to your kind.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: You can earn Demonic Pact points by completing specific combat tasks.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: These points can be spent to unlock abilities and progress through the pacts in a manner that suits your preference for combat.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: There are many choices available, but you will not be able to select them all. Plan ahead and choose wisely.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Now, would you like to take a look at the Demonic Pacts available to you?
Opens Leagues Demonic Pacts panel

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Very well. Is there anything else you need from me?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks you complete, the more areas become available to unlock.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic. These artefacts have been reshaped by Yama and his cohort to grant new powers.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
As we speak, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.player: So how many tasks are there?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. It's up to you which ones you attempt.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?
Opens Leagues Tasks panel

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you need from me?

options.text: How does the area system work?

steps.player: How does the area system work?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Currently, you are restricted to the Kingdom of Varlamore. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Once you have proven yourself dedicated to the League, Yama will also grant you free access to Karamja.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: There are eleven different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including the two you are gifted. Choose wisely.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: The first two area unlocks are given to everyone. You can unlock the other three by completing the tasks you have been set.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: The more tasks you complete, the more areas you can unlock.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?
Opens Leagues Areas panel

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Fair enough. Is there anything else you need from me?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Relics are powerful artefacts made by me that grant unique abilities for the entire League.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: You may even recognise a few from Leagues past.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: There are 23 separate Relics, split across 8 different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier, however.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: The first Relic tier is available to everyone. The others must be unlocked with League Points.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: League Points are earned by completing tasks.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League. Make your choices carefully.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Would you like to take a look at the Relics for this League?
Opens Leagues Relics panel

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Fair enough. Is there anything else you need from me?

options.text: Can I claim some Combat rewards?

steps.player: Can I claim some combat achievement rewards?

steps.text: No claimable rewards:

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: You do not appear to have any combat achievement rewards available to claim.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Relic tiers you have available.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: However, alongside allowing you to unlock Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Oh, all sorts of things. New cosmetic kits, an alternative Home Teleport animation, some rather stylish outfits... and much more.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Many of these rewards can be traded with your fellow mortals, so if you wish, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.

steps.player: I see. That all sounds good to me.

steps.text: Currently, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be used to buy items on your main profile, although you can still browse the shop within the League.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Would you like to look at the rewards shop?

steps.prompt: Open rewards shop?

steps.text: Opens Rewards shop

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: You can use this shop to buy previous League rewards, too.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.

steps.player: League Ranks? How do they work?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: During the League as you gain more points you will gain a League Rank. This rank can be seen in the Ranks interface.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: You currently have the rank: Unranked.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: As you get ranks you will gain access to trophies.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: That's right. Trophies are items that are awarded to you for competing in the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. In addition, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: My pleasure. Now, is there anything else you need from me?

steps.player: Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: But of course. If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: This means that if you lose it somehow you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free of charge.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. I'll take good care of it until you're ready to reclaim it.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection. Now, is there anything else you need from me?

in-member-s-world-talk-to-in-a-non-leagu.text: Hello there. Do you have any questions about Leagues?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Leagues are time-limited challenges that provide a unique twist on the world you know and love.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the League.

steps.player: A fresh start? Why would I want that?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Glory, rewards, and the chance to do things in a different way!

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: The more points you have, the better League Rank you will be given.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off your accomplishments.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: If that doesn't interest you, perhaps another reward might be more appealing? League Points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to others!

steps.player: And if glory and rewards don't interest me?

steps.text: Every League has unique rules and features. It's a very different world from the one you're used to.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: For one thing, within the Leagues, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics which completely change the way you progress.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: So even if glory and rewards aren't your thing, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!

options.text: Is there currently a League running?

steps.player: Is there currently a League running?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Yes! The current League is Leagues V: Raging Echoes.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: This League features powerful boss variants in each region, and Combat Masteries to enhance your chosen combat style's strengths.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: As usual, you are restricted to certain regions around Gielinor - although you'll get to choose which ones.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: You can also collect powerful artifacts known as Relics. Each one provides a different buff to your League experience.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: There's one that lets you keep a kingdom in your pocket, and one that lets you become a Slayer Master!

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: One other thing. You must participate as an Ironman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.

steps.player: Interesting. Maybe I should take part!

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: I'd highly recommend it!
To take part in a League, you must be on a Leagues World. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

during-in-a-league-world.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during-in-a-league-world.text: Hello! Do you have any questions for me?

options.text: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.player: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: All sorts of things! I can't recount all of the information for you, but I can give you the basics though.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: During this League, you are initially restricted to the Kingdom of Misthalin. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Now, for the entire League, you must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect!

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: I think that covers the basics. Would you like to see some more in-depth information?
Trailblazer Info interface opens.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Fair enough. Is there anything else I can help you with?
other

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks completed, the more areas available to unlock.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic! These are powerful artefacts to help you in the League.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.player: So how many tasks are there?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. With so many to choose from, it's up to you which ones you go for.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Not a problem. Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?
Trailblazer Task interface opens.

options.text: How does the area system work?

steps.player: How does the area system work?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: In this League, you are initially locked to the Kingdom of Misthalin and the island of Karamja. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: There are nine different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including Misthalin and Karamja, so choose wisely.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: The first two area unlocks are given to everyone. However, the other three unlocks are unavailable to begin with.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: You can access these additional area unlocks by completing tasks. The more tasks you've completed, the more areas you can unlock.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?
Trailblazer Task interface opens.

steps.player: How does the area system work?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Relics, or Trailblazer Relics to give them their full name, are powerful artefacts that grant unique abilities for the entire League!

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: There are eighteen separate Relics, split across six different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier though.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: The first Relic tier is available to everyone. However, the higher tiers are locked to begin with.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: You can unlock these higher tiers by earning League Points. League Points are earned by completing tasks.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Be warned, you'll need to choose carefully when picking a Relic. Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Anyway, it looks like you have a Relic available for selection right now! Would you like to take a look?
Trailblazer Relic interface opens.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Trailblazer Relic tiers you have available.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: However, alongside allowing you to unlock Trailblazer Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: All sorts of things! There's some new furniture for your house, an alternate animation for your Home Teleport spell and some new stylish outfits, just to name a few.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Most of the rewards can be traded with others, so if you want, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.

steps.player: I see. That all sounds good to me.

steps.text: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: One thing to be aware of is that the Trailblazer rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues though.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.

steps.player: League Ranks? How do they work?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: At the end of the League, you will be given a League Rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: When the League ends, your rank will determine what trophy you get. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: That's right. Trophies are items that are given to you after the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank!

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one!

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Not a problem. Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
other

steps.player: Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: No worries. Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection! Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
other

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: Hello! Welcome to the Twisted League. I see you are new here.

during.player: Yes, this is my first League. Can you explain how they work?

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: First of all, I'm your Leagues Tutor. If you have any questions about how Leagues work, you can come to me for help.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: Now, Leagues are time-limited modes that give you a new way to play the game. For this League, you are restricted to the Kourend and Kebos regions, and you play as an Iron Man.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: Let's take a look at all of the information available about this League. There is a new section in the journal tab whilst on a Leagues world. Click on the flashing quest icon to take a look.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: Now that you have your journal open, click on the flashing Leagues icon.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: This is the Leagues menu. Here you can view your progress through the current League. You can also open the various Leagues interfaces from here.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: Your objective in each League is to complete tasks and earn League Points.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: Tasks are split into five difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master. The harder the task, the more points awarded.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: Let's have a look at the tasks interface now. Click on the flashing button to open it.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: This is the tasks interface. Here you can see all the tasks available to you in this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: Earning points during the League will allow you to unlock powerful Twisted Relics. The more League Points you have, the more Relics available to you.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: League Points are also transferred over to your main profile. There, they can be spent on rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: Now let's have a look at the Twisted Relics. Click on the flashing button to take a look at the Relics interface.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: This is the Relics interface. Here you can unlock new Twisted Relics to be used during this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: There are a few changes to Kourend and Kebos which you may not be used to. You can view all of these changes on the information interface.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: Right, I think that's everything. If you need reminding of any of this information, you can either talk to me or read the information interface.

during.speaker: Leagues Tutor
during.text: Before you head off though, it's time to pick your first Relic! Choose carefully though, once you've picked a Relic you can't go back and change your decision.

after.speaker: Leagues Tutor
after.text: I'm the Tutor for Old School Leagues.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Old School Leagues are time-limited game modes that are separate from your main profile.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the game mode.

steps.player: So it's a fresh start? Why would I want that?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Glory, gold, and the chance to play the game in a different way!

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: The more points you have at the end of the League, the better League Rank you will be given.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off how well you did.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: If that doesn't interest you, how about gold! When you earn League Points, they will be transferred over to your main profile.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: These points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop. You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to other players!

steps.player: And if glory and gold don't interest me?

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Leagues aren't just a copy of the normal game. Every League has unique rules and features to set it aside from the game you're used to.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: Not only that, but within each League, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics. These Relics completely change the way you play the game!

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: So even if glory and gold are not for you, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!

steps.player: I see, thanks for the information.

steps.speaker: Leagues Tutor
steps.text: My pleasure!

steps.player: Can you give me any farming advice?

steps.npc: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're good enough at crafting, that is.
Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're good enough at crafting, that is.
If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.

Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.

There are many Farming areas out there. I know of Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in
the Farming Guild. That said, I'm sure there's plenty more that I don't know about.

standard-dialogue-first-talk.npc: Welcome, are you looking to take part in a game of Last Man Standing?

steps.npc: It's simple. Anyone looking to participate enters the relevant waiting area. Once the waiting area has enough people, they are taken to the arena.
Indeed. We have set up two arenas on another plane. When a game starts, we pick one at random. Once everyone arrives in the arena, the fight for survival begins.
Now, there's a few important things to be aware of. While in an arena, your physical and mental abilities will be boosted. Also, praying to the gods will not cost you any precious energies.
After a game has started, lethal fog will soon start filling the arena. This forces contenders to a designated safe zone and ensures no one escapes the fighting.
Be aware, you can't take any of your own belongings into the game. Instead, you can use only what you find in the arena, including anything we give you on arrival.
Regarding what you are given on arrival, you have a few options to pick from. Use my supply chest to configure your load-outs for the different battle styles.
Remember, this is a solo competition! Anyone attempting to form teams for an unfair advantage will be banished from further participation.
Now that you know more, would you like to take part in a game of Last Man Standing?

steps.player: Tell me more about the Wintertodt.

steps.npc: The Wintertodt is a fiercely cold being, capable of freezing entire areas with its mere presence. We do not know what exactly the Wintertodt is, nor where it came from.
When the Wintertodt first attacked, it was feared that all of Kourend would be lost. Fortunately, the Order of the Sacred Flame and Dinh the Master Smith were able to stop it.

options.text: How did they stop the Wintertodt?

steps.player: How did they stop the Wintertodt?

steps.npc: Dinh was a great smith and engineer. He uncovered the power of the Bruma tree. Using bark from the tree and various metal compounds, Dinh forged the doors of the prison that hold the Wintertodt.
In addition, the Order of the Sacred Flame utilised the Bruma tree in firemaking. They heated the environment to subdue Wintertodt.

steps.text: other

options.text: Tell me more about the invasion.
Tell me more about the invasion.

steps.player: Tell me more about the invasion.

steps.npc: More than 137 decades ago, seemingly from nowhere, the Wintertodt began terrorising the lands north of Kourend, freezing everything within its path.
After five decades of this terror, the people of Kourend were able to quell the beast, containing it in an icy prison.
The Wintertodt remained subdued until very recently, when it began to threaten Kourend once more.
Fortunately, the Order of the Sacred Flame is able to contain the Wintertodt and prevent another attack.
